• Do you thrive on challenging supplier pricing and uncovering cost-saving opportunities?
• Are you equally comfortable with data analysis and commercial negotiations?
• Looking for a dynamic role in an international environment where no two days are the same?
Then this opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Your role as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You define the Value Management strategy and roadmap for Business Solutions, focused on retention, renewals and gross margin protection. 

• You identify the main drivers of churn, revenue erosion and value leakage, and translate data and customer insights into high-impact actions. 

• You connect customer outcomes with financial impact and balance customer needs with sustainable value creation. 

• You drive a cross-functional value agenda across Product & Journey, Commercial, Delivery & Services and Operations, securing ownership and commitment. 

• You build and lead a multidisciplinary team, set priorities and develop its analytical, commercial and influencing capabilities. 

• You establish governance, KPIs and decision forums that make customer value and gross margin visible in business decisions. 

• You determine priorities and trade-offs, monitor progress and intervene when delivery or impact stalls.  

Your profile as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in Value Management, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention, CX, Commercial Strategy or Business Transformation within a complex B2B environment, including 2 years in a leadership role.

• You build coalitions, negotiate priorities and create ownership beyond your own team, including without direct authority.

• You are decisive and outcome-oriented, and comfortably balance customer needs, commercial ambitions and organizational realities.

Coordinate foundry orders and logistics so semiconductor projects move accurately and efficiently from reservation to delivery.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Are you passionate about technology?
 

Are you interested in supporting a world-class team of engineers?
 

Would you like to help customers innovate and optimize their timelines?
 

The world of chip manufacturing is an interesting and diverse environment. Our enthusiastic and diverse team collaborates with imec’s customers to make their projects become reality. We are eager to welcome new team members to step into this magnificent world and get familiar with the processes of manufacturing chips.
 

Imec.IC-link helps customers design chips and bring them to the prototype and the mass production stage at top chip foundries. Imec is a qualified TSMC Value Chain Alliance partner and offers state-of-the-art prototype and volume fabrication services to fabless companies and system houses. Imec.IC link provides its customers with specialized technical solutions for the design prototyping, and mass production of chips.
 

As a Fulfilment Operations Officer, you act as a key link between customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal teams. You ensure that operational activities run smoothly by coordinating orders, deliveries, documentation, and logistics processes from start to finish. You monitor progress, maintain accurate information in the relevant systems, and proactively address issues to ensure customer commitments are met.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Coordinating operational activities with customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. 

• Ensuring orders, requests, and related information are complete, accurate, and processed on time. 

• Supporting production planning and capacity allocation activities. 

• Managing the flow of products, materials, and deliveries throughout the supply chain. 

• Maintaining accurate operational data and visibility in the relevant systems and tools. 

• Preparing and reviewing required logistics, shipping, and compliance documentation. 

• Monitoring operational performance and following up on open actions and exceptions. 

• Investigating and resolving day-to-day issues related to orders, deliveries, logistics, invoicing, and other operational processes. 

• Driving effective communication across stakeholders to ensure timely and successful execution of customer projects. 

Who you are
 

Helping people makes you happy!
 
 

• You enjoy bringing structure to complex operational work and helping customers and colleagues move projects forward. 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree or have equivalent relevant experience in logistics, operations, supply chain, business support or a related field. 

• You communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and are comfortable working with international customers and suppliers. 

• You are customer-focused, accurate and organised, and you can manage several open actions and deadlines at the same time. 

• You take initiative, investigate inconsistencies and coordinate with the right owners rather than letting operational issues remain unresolved. 

• You are eager to learn about semiconductor manufacturing and foundry operations. Prior semiconductor experience is an asset, not a requirement. 

• You are comfortable learning and using business systems. Experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or other similar systems is an asset.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Who are we?  

In today's digital world, prevention alone is no longer enough. Organisations need strong detection and response capabilities to identify and address threats quickly. That is where we come in. From Belgium and the Netherlands, we help organisations further develop their security capabilities. Our clients are among the top 200 companies in the Benelux and are active in a wide range of sectors. At Davinsi Labs, we collaborate closely, share knowledge and build an environment where expertise, initiative and growth are central.  

Your mission  

You will be part of our Managed Detection and Response organisation and work within the Microsoft Sentinel team. As a Microsoft Sentinel Security Engineer, you build and improve the technical capabilities on which our security services run. Your focus is not only on managing Sentinel, but above all on developing scalable, automated and reusable solutions for multiple client environments. You work at the intersection of security engineering, Azure, automation, detection engineering and AI. You develop new platform features, automate onboarding and configuration, build integrations and ensure that our Sentinel environments can be managed reliably and efficiently.  

Responsibilities  

You build and improve our Microsoft Sentinel platform capabilities and help shape how we can further standardise and automate our managed service. Among other things, you work on onboarding new clients, data integrations, deployment of security content, health monitoring and automation of operational processes. In addition, you develop new AI capabilities within our security service. You explore how AI can be used to accelerate detection engineering, make threat hunting smarter, better enrich threat intelligence and support security analysts in investigation and decision-making. You build proofs of concept and help turn successful ideas into robust, secure and reusable platform functionalities. You work with Git, CI/CD, scripting and APIs to manage configurations, security content and automation as code as much as possible. You work closely with detection engineers and SOC analysts and ensure that the platform offers them the right capabilities for detection, investigation and response.  

Your profile

You have experience as a Security Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer, SIEM Engineer or in a comparable technical role. You have knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel or a comparable SIEM platform and feel comfortable working within Microsoft Azure. You are interested in automation, development and AI, and enjoy experimenting with new technologies that can improve security processes. You have experience with scripting, APIs, Git or CI/CD. Knowledge of KQL, Microsoft Defender XDR, Entra ID, Infrastructure as Code or AI/LLM integrations is a strong asset. You like to think beyond a single configuration or client and look for structural solutions that are scalable and reusable. You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, enjoy working in a team and have an analytical, solution-oriented mindset.

You’ve worked registry-side or registrar-side. Here, the registration platform is the product, and you own its roadmap.

Product Owner | Domain Registration Platform | Brussels area

Our client is a European not-for-profit organisation, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, that manages and operates one of the world’s largest country-code top-level domains in the public interest.

What makes it stand out? It never sells to end users. Everything runs through a network of accredited registrars, so the EPP interface, the registration APIs and the lifecycle rules are the product, and the people on the other side of them are hosting providers and registrars across Europe.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to a service registrars depend on every day.

The organisation is therefore looking for a Product Owner who already comes from this ecosystem — registry, registrar, hosting or registry back-end — and can hold a credible technical conversation with registrars from the first weeks.

All of this from offices in the Brussels area, within a multicultural team that works in English.

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog of the registration platform and of the domain-name lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate registrar needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, RDAP, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience and long-term sustainability.
• Act as the product counterpart for the accredited registrar channel: understand how they integrate, what breaks for them and what they need next.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2 and internal governance frameworks, and follow developments within ICANN, IETF and CENTR.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 7+ years in technology-driven products or services, with real ownership as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Hands-on experience in the domain-name ecosystem is required, from either side of the Registry-Registrar-Registrant model: a ccTLD or gTLD registry, a registry back-end provider, a registrar or a hosting provider. Concretely, you have worked with EPP, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS provisioning, domain lifecycle processes or registry-to-registrar integrations. Candidates without exposure to this ecosystem cannot be considered.
• Based in Belgium, with excellent written and spoken English; other European languages are an asset.

Responsibilities

• Coach and guide multiple development teams in daily practices such as pair programming, mob programming, and joint refactoring.
• Advise teams on testing strategies including TDD, unit, integration, and contract testing within CI/CD pipelines.
• Facilitate the adoption of Trunk-Based Development and modern source control workflows to replace traditional merge request models.
• Guide architectural design decisions and foster a common technical culture across the organization.
• Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the developer experience, focusing on build times, pipeline reliability, and deployment processes.
• Implement a structured improvement cycle to identify, test, and measure the impact of technical enhancements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in designing maintainable software using Java 21, DDD, Clean Architecture, and Hexagonal Architecture.
• 8+ years implementing engineering practices including TDD, Trunk-Based Development, and GitLab CI.
• 8+ years defining automated testing strategies across unit, integration, and contract levels as executable documentation.
• 5+ years facilitating Mob programming, Ensemble programming, and Software Teaming.
• 5+ years coaching developers and teams on complex problems to foster technical autonomy.
• 5+ years of experience working within a LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum) framework.
• You possess strong leadership skills with the ability to influence others without hierarchical authority.
• You bring a proactive approach to change management and are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback.
• You are fluent in Dutch and French with a professional level of English.
